Constitution of CAD Board.-- As soon as may be after the commencement of this Act, the Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, constitute one or more Command Area Development Boards (hereinafter called the 'CAD Boards') for the command area of each major and medium irrigation projects in the State of Goa. Such Board(s) shall have autonomy in administrative and financial matters. The Command Area Development Board shall a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal. The Board shall be so constituted as to represent all the water users' associations in the command area. The Board shall have such other officers and employees as may be required for efficient discharge of its functions. The Board shall have a full time Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and such other officers and employees as may be required for efficient discharge of its functions. The CEO shall be appointed by the Government and shall be a person with proven administrative experience in the field of irrigation, agriculture, water management and land development. The CEO shall be responsible for the day to day administration of the Board and shall carry out the decisions of the Board and its committees. The CEO shall be responsible to the Board for the efficient discharge of his functions. The CEO shall have such other powers and functions as may be prescribed. The Board may, subject to the provisions of this Act and the rules made thereunder, make regulations for carrying out its functions. The Board shall have the power to make regulations for the conduct of its business, and the constitution of committees and for other matters which by this Act are required to be or may be prescribed by regulations. Every regulation made under this section shall, as soon as may be after it is made, be placed before the State Legislature. All regulations made under this section shall be published in the Official Gazette. A copy of every regulation made under this section shall be laid, as soon as may be after it is made, before the State Legislature. Every regulation made under this section shall be binding on all the persons. The Board may establish a fund to be called the Command Area Development Fund. There shall be credited to the Fund,-- (i) all grants and loans made to the Board by the Government; (ii) all sums received by the Board from such other sources as may be decided by the Board. The Board may maintain sub-accounts of the Fund for each of the water users' association. The State Government shall, as soon as may be after the commencement of this Act, constitute a Municipal Service Commission by the name of the West Bengal Municipal Service Commission. The West Bengal Municipal Service Commission shall consist of a Chairman and not more than three other members. Appointment and terms and conditions of service of Chairman and Members. The Commission shall function under the administrative control of the State Government in the Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Department. The Chairman and other members shall be appointed by the State Government on the recommendation of a Selection Committee consisting of the following members, namely:-- (a) the Chief Secretary to the Government of West Bengal, Chairperson; (b) the Principal Secretary to the Government of West Bengal, Department of Urban Development and Municipal Affairs, Member; (c) the Principal Secretary to the Government of West Bengal, Department of Finance, Member; (d) the Principal Secretary to the Government of West Bengal, Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms, Member; (e) the Secretary to the Commission, Member-Secretary. The Selection Committee shall consider the names of persons recommended by the Commission and make recommendations to the State Government. The members of the Commission shall hold office for such period, not exceeding three years, as may be prescribed. The State Government shall provide the Commission with such officers and employees as that Government may think fit. The terms and conditions of the officers and employees of the Commission shall be such as may be prescribed.
